data.title: Saudi U17 National Team Defeats France to Claim First Win at 2026 FIFA U-17 World Cup
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The Saudi U17 national team secured its first victory at the 2026 FIFA U-17 World Cup in Qatar after defeating France 1-0 on Sunday at Aspire Academy Pitch 5 in Doha, in the second round of Group D matches.
    The first half ended in a goalless draw before Saudi player Shaman Al-Qahtani scored the match's only goal in the 73rd minute, securing three crucial points for his team.
    With the victory, Saudi Arabia raised its tally to three points, bouncing back from a 3-2 defeat to Uruguay in the opening round and keeping its hopes of qualifying for the round of 32 alive. The team will face Haiti on Wednesday in its third and final group-stage match.
    -- SPA
